Expected ~24 dispatches (8 intra-node + 8 inter-node + 8 broadcast) but leverages faster intra-node links to amortize repeated reductions over smaller world sizes.

strategies.name: Ring All-Reduce with Inline Coupling

strategies.name: Bucketed Pipelined All-Reduce Chunks
strategies.desc:
Partition the full tensor into K buckets, launch all-reduce on bucket 1 while computing coupling for bucket 0 results, overlapping communication and computation across stages. Expected 8*K dispatches where K is chosen to balance bucket size vs pipeline depth, trading increased dispatch count for latency hiding through software pipelining.
